title: What game did you publish on Google Play Store?
author: Need300dollars

comments.author: Need300dollars
comments.body: Does this mean nobody publish mobile games? Even so some people get thousands with just ads and a simple game? I guess the vision of mobile game is really low. And of course, is obvious if you see old comparisions with Steam games. But, even so, it is still a way of income and not that difficult, just a good idea of an idea is enough. Ah, and marketing, like always.
